score_2: supported and appropriate to visible input/version
review_required: Independent human reviewer; AI-assisted review is separate and does not complete this requirement.

criteria.evidence_relevance_0_2: Relation of cited accepted evidence to this case: 0 absent/unrelated, 1 indirect/partial, 2 directly relevant. Retrieved-but-uncited evidence does not automatically earn credit.
criteria.claim_support_0_2: Support for the actual explanation/recommendation: 0 material false attribution or unsupported conclusion, 1 partial support or material overstatement, 2 supported or explicitly bounded abstention.
criteria.version_fit_0_2: 0 incompatible recommendation or material unqualified version transfer; 1 environment/version uncertain, incompletely tracked or applicability not established; 2 appropriate applicability or abstention with no version claim.
criteria.next_step_usefulness_0_2: 0 irrelevant/redundant/non-executable, 1 partially actionable or safe but generic escalation, 2 targeted new diagnostic/action or appropriate feature referral.
criteria.avoids_repeated_check_0_2: 0 substantially repeats information/checks already visible in initial input; 1 mixed/new and redundant or merely repeats the requested goal; 2 no repeated check. Full initial text takes precedence over empty structured check lists.
criteria.overall_0_2: Holistic quality: 0 material wrong/non-executable answer or no useful progress, 1 partly useful with material limitations, 2 supported and useful. Not the arithmetic mean of dimension scores.

safe_fallback_policy: Invalid-citation fallback is scored as delivered: evidence 0, claim support 2, version fit 2, usefulness 1, avoids repetition 2, overall 1. Safety scores do not imply a resolved issue.
